WITH TMP_CRMCCDSEC
AS
(
    SELECT BC.CUSTOMERID 
    ,BCTN.TelephoneNumber               AS MobileNumber
    ,BCE.EmailAddress                   AS Email
    ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine1          AS AddressLine1
    ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine2          AS AddressLine2
    ,BCTY.CityName                      AS City
    ,BSTT.StateName                     AS Province
    ,BLOC.LocationZipCode               AS ZipCode
    ,BLOC.CountryId                     AS Country
    ,BCST.ConsentName                   AS DataPrivacyConsent
    ,BACT.CustomerActionTimestamp       AS LastKYCDate
    ,BOCR.RiskRatingTypeId              AS RiskRatingTypeSK
    ,BCR.CreditRiskName                 AS RiskRatingSK
    ,BEMP.EmployerName                  AS EmployerName
    ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine1          AS OfficeAddressLine1
    ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine2          AS OfficeAddressLine2
    ,BCTY2.CityName                     AS OfficeCity
    ,BSTT2.StateName                    AS OfficeProvince
    ,BEMP.ZipCode                       AS OfficeZipCode
    ,BCTRY.IsoCountryName               AS OfficeCountry
    ,BAZC.AnzsicClassName               AS Industry
    ,BJT.JobTitleName                   AS Occupation
    ,BC.SourceSystemCode                AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BC.FinancialInstitutionId          AS FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM (SELECT CUSTOMERID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.Customer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM') BC
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,TelephoneNumber FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y') BCTN ON BC.CustomerId = BCTN.CustomerId  
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,ConsentId FROM  BNKM.CustomerConsent) BCC ON BC.CustomerId = BCC.CustomerId  --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ConsentId,ConsentName FROM BNKM.Consent) BCST ON BCC.ConsentId = BCST.ConsentId --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,CustomerActionTimestamp FROM BNKM.CustomerAction) BACT ON BC.CustomerId = BACT.CustomerId  --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,RiskRatingTypeId,CreditRiskId FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating) BOCR ON BC.CustomerId = BOCR.CustomerId  --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT RiskRatingTypeId,RiskRatingTypeName FROM BNKM.RiskRatingType) BRRT ON BOCR.RiskRatingTypeId = BRRT.RiskRatingTypeId --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CreditRiskId,CreditRiskName FROM BNKM.CreditRisk) BCR ON BOCR.CreditRiskId = BCR.CreditRiskId  --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,LocationId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y') BCL ON BC.CustomerId = BCL.CustomerId 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT LocationId,LocationAddressLine1,LocationAddressLine2,LocationZipCode,CountryId ,LocationCity,LocationStateId  FROM BNKM.Location) BLOC ON BCL.LocationId = BLOC.LocationId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmailTypeId,EmailAddress FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y') BCE ON BC.CustomerId = BCE.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CityId,CityName FROM BNKM.City) BCTY ON BLOC.LocationCity = BCTY.CityId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT StateId,StateName FROM BNKM.[STATE]) BSTT   ON BLOC.LocationStateId = BSTT.StateId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmployerId,JobTitleId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL) BCEMP ON BC.CustomerId = BCEMP.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT EmployerId,EmployerName,EmployerAddressLine1,EmployerAddressLine2,CityId,StateId,ZipCode,Country,AnzsicClassCode FROM BNKM.Employer) BEMP ON BCEMP.EmployerId = BEMP.EmployerId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CityId,CityName FROM BNKM.City) BCTY2 ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BEMP.CityId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCTY2.CityId)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT StateId,StateName FROM BNKM.[STATE]) BSTT2   ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BEMP.StateId) = convert(varchar,BSTT2.StateId)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CountryId,IsoCountryName FROM BNKM.Country) BCTRY ON  BEMP.Country = convert(varchar,BCTRY.CountryId)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT AnzsicClassCode,AnzsicClassName FROM BNKM.AnzsicClass) BAZC ON BEMP.AnzsicClassCode = BAZC.AnzsicClassCode
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT JobTitleId,JobTitleName FROM BNKM.JobTitle)  BJT ON BCEMP.JobTitleId = BJT.JobTitleId

    

    UNION ALL

    SELECT BC.CUSTOMERID 
    ,BCTN.TelephoneNumber               AS MobileNumber
    ,BCE.EmailAddress                   AS Email
    ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine1          AS AddressLine1
    ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine2          AS AddressLine2   
    ,BLOC.LocationCity                  AS City
    ,BLOC.LocationStateId               AS Province
    ,BLOC.LocationZipCode               AS ZipCode 
    ,BLOC.CountryId                     AS Country
    ,NULL                               AS DataPrivacyConsent
    ,NULL                               AS LastKYCDate
    ,'TU Score'                         AS RiskRatingTypeSK
    ,BCCA.RiskRating                    AS RiskRatingSK   
    ,BEMP.EmployerName                  AS EmployerName
    ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine1          AS OfficeAddressLine1
    ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine2          AS OfficeAddressLine2 
    ,BEMP.CityId                        AS OfficeCity
    ,BEMP.StateId                       AS OfficeProvince
    ,BEMP.ZipCode                       AS OfficeZipCode
    ,BEMP.Country                       AS OfficeCountry
    ,BEMP.AnzsicClassCode               AS Industry
    ,BCEMP.JobTitleId                   AS Occupation
    ,BC.SourceSystemCode                AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BC.FinancialInstitutionId          AS FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM (SELECT CUSTOMERID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.Customer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD') BC
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,TelephoneNumber FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber BCTN
               JOIN (SELECT TelephoneNumberTypeId FROM BNKM.TelephoneNumberType WHERE TelephoneNumberTypeName = 'Mobile Number') BTNT ON BCTN.TelephoneNumberTypeId = BTNT.TelephoneNumberTypeId
               ) BCTN ON BC.CustomerId = BCTN.CustomerId  
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,RiskRating FROM BNKM.CreditCardApplication) BCCA ON BC.CustomerId = BCCA.CustomerId --CCD
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,LocationId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE LocationTypeId = '1') BCL ON BC.CustomerId = BCL.CustomerId 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT LocationId,LocationAddressLine1,LocationAddressLine2,LocationCity,LocationStateId,LocationZipCode,CountryId FROM BNKM.Location) BLOC ON BCL.LocationId = BLOC.LocationId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmailAddress FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail BCE
                JOIN (SELECT EmailTypeId FROM BNKM.EmailType WHERE EmailTypeTypeName = 'Primary') BET ON BCE.EmailTypeId = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BET.EmailTypeId)
                ) BCE ON BC.CustomerId = BCE.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmployerId,JobTitleId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL) BCEMP ON BC.CustomerId = BCEMP.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT EmployerId,EmployerName,EmployerAddressLine1,EmployerAddressLine2,CityId,StateId,ZipCode,Country,AnzsicClassCode FROM BNKM.Employer) BEMP ON BCEMP.EmployerId = BEMP.EmployerId
    


    UNION ALL

    SELECT BC.CUSTOMERID 
    ,BCTN.TelephoneNumber               AS MobileNumber
    ,BCE.EmailAddress                   AS Email
    ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine1          AS AddressLine1
    ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine2          AS AddressLine2
    ,BLOC.LocationCity                  AS City   
    ,BLOC.LocationStateId               AS Province 
    ,BLOC.LocationZipCode               AS ZipCode
    ,BLOC.CountryId                     AS Country
    ,CASE WHEN BCARD.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL THEN 'OPTED IN FOR ALL'
     ELSE NULL END                      AS DataPrivacyConsent
    ,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate     AS LastKYCDate
    ,'ECRAF'                            AS RiskRatingTypeSK
    ,BSC.RiskClass                      AS RiskRatingSK
    ,BEMP.EmployerName                  AS EmployerName
    ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine1          AS OfficeAddressLine1
    ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine2          AS OfficeAddressLine2
    ,BEMP.CityId                        AS OfficeCity
    ,BEMP.StateId                       AS OfficeProvince
    ,BEMP.ZipCode                       AS OfficeZipCode
    ,BEMP.Country                       AS OfficeCountry
    ,BEMP.BusinessNature                AS Industry
    ,BCEMP.JobTitleId                   AS Occupation
    ,BC.SourceSystemCode                AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BC.FinancialInstitutionId          AS FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM (SELECT CUSTOMERID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.Customer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC') BC
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,TelephoneNumber FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber BCTN
               JOIN (SELECT TelephoneNumberTypeId FROM BNKM.TelephoneNumberType WHERE TelephoneNumberTypeName = 'Cellphone Number') BTNT ON BCTN.TelephoneNumberTypeId = BTNT.TelephoneNumberTypeId
               ) BCTN ON BC.CustomerId = BCTN.CustomerId 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,CustomerAccountId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation) BCAP ON BC.CustomerId = BCAP.CustomerId  --SEC
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId) CustomerAccountId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount) BCARD ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCARD.CustomerAccountId --SEC
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId) CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountOpenedDate FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId --SEC
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,RiskClass FROM BNKM.SecuritiesCustomer) BSC ON BC.CustomerId = BSC.CustomerId  --SEC
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,LocationId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE LocationTypeId = 'Home') BCL ON BC.CustomerId = BCL.CustomerId 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT LocationId,LocationAddressLine1,LocationAddressLine2,LocationCity,LocationStateId,LocationZipCode,CountryId FROM BNKM.Location) BLOC ON BCL.LocationId = BLOC.LocationId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmailAddress FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail BCE
                JOIN (SELECT EmailTypeId FROM BNKM.EmailType WHERE EmailTypeTypeName = 'Primary') BET ON BCE.EmailTypeId = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BET.EmailTypeId)
                ) BCE ON BC.CustomerId = BCE.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmployerId,JobTitleId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL) BCEMP ON BC.CustomerId = BCEMP.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT EmployerId,EmployerName,EmployerAddressLine1,EmployerAddressLine2,CityId,StateId,ZipCode,Country,BusinessNature FROM BNKM.Employer) BEMP ON CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),BCEMP.EmployerId,1) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),BEMP.EmployerId,1)

)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_CRMCCDSEC FROM TMP_CRMCCDSEC;


WITH
CustomerSK
as (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomer
)
--SRC
INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomer 
(
 [CustomerSK]
,[CustomerID]
,[CustomerName]
,[CustomerType]
,[DateOfBirth]
,[MaritalStatus]
,[Gender]
,[MobileNumber]
,[Email]
,[AddressLine1]
,[AddressLine2]
,[City]
,[Province]
,[ZipCode]
,[Country]
,[DataPrivacyConsent]
,[LastKYCDate]
,[RiskRatingTypeSK]
,[RiskRatingSK]
,[SuspendedIndicator]
,[RelationshipStartDate]
,[PartySK]
,[ATMEnrollmentIndicator]
,[MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator]
,[OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator]
,[GenerationalCohort]
,[PermanentCreditLimit]
,[EmployerName]
,[OfficeAddressLine1]
,[OfficeAddressLine2]
,[OfficeCity]
,[OfficeProvince]
,[OfficeZipCode]
,[OfficeCountry]
,[Industry]
,[Occupation]
,[BankSK]
,[BranchSK]
,[CurrentIndicator]
,[ValidStartDate]
,[ValidEndDate]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm]   
)
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM CustomerSK)  AS CustomerSK
,BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID
,BIC.IndividualCustomerName AS CustomerName
,BCT.CustomerTypeName AS CustomerType
,BIC.DateOfBirth AS DateOfBirth
,BMS.MaritalStatusName AS MaritalStatus
,BG.GenderName AS Gender
,TMPCCS.MobileNumber AS MobileNumber
,TMPCCS.Email AS Email
,TMPCCS.AddressLine1 AS AddressLine1
,TMPCCS.AddressLine2 AS AddressLine2
,TMPCCS.City AS City
,TMPCCS.Province AS Province
,TMPCCS.ZipCode AS ZipCode
,TMPCCS.Country AS Country
,TMPCCS.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent
,TMPCCS.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
,TMPCCS.RiskRatingTypeSK AS RiskRatingTypeSK
,TMPCCS.RiskRatingSK AS RiskRatingSK
,NULL AS SuspendedIndicator
,NULL AS RelationshipStartDate
,NULL AS PartySK
,CASE WHEN BCRC.RelatedCustomerId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,CASE WHEN BCA.CustomerId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator --MBK
,CASE WHEN BCA2.CustomerId IS NOT NULL --OR BCAP.CoreCustomerId IS NOT NULL 
THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator --RIB/BOB
,NULL AS GenerationalCohort
,NULL AS PermanentCreditLimit
,TMPCCS.EmployerName
,TMPCCS.OfficeAddressLine1
,TMPCCS.OfficeAddressLine2
,TMPCCS.OfficeCity
,TMPCCS.OfficeProvince
,TMPCCS.OfficeZipCode
,TMPCCS.OfficeCountry
,TMPCCS.Industry
,TMPCCS.Occupation
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,BC.BranchId AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.Customer BC
JOIN BNKM.IndividualCustomer BIC ON BC.CustomerId  = BIC.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerType BCT ON BC.CustomerTypeId= CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCT.CustomerTypeId)
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus BCMS ON BC.CustomerId = BCMS.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.MaritalStatus BMS ON BCMS.MaritalStatusId  = convert(varchar,BMS.MaritalStatusId)
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Gender BG ON BIC.GenderId = convert(varchar,BG.GenderId)
JOIN #TMP_CRMCCDSEC TMPCCS ON BC.CustomerId = TMPCCS.CUSTOMERID AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = TMPCCS.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer BCRC ON BC.CustomerId = BCRC.RelatedCustomerId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BC.CustomerId = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.CustomerId) and BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'MBK' --MBK
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA2 ON BC.CustomerId = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA2.CustomerId) and BCA2.SourceSystemCode = 'RIB' --RIB
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT CoreCustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP
--            JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId FROM BNKM.BusinessOnlineBankingAccount) BOBA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BOBA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP','LNS')
--            ) BCAP ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BC.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
